# Untying Prefill and Decode Loops in Looped Language Models

> Looped (recurrent-depth) language models use the same number of loops to read the prompt (prefill) and to generate
> each answer token (decode), although generation is almost all decoding. We untie the two loop counts (prefill m
> loops, decode n < m) and distill a small adapter from the original four-loop model: LoRA on the decoder for a fixed
> prefill depth ("Ours, fixed m"), or LoopBridge (LoRA + per-loop key/value maps) for every (m, n) with one set of
> weights ("Ours, any m"). Ouro-2.6B, Ouro-1.4B, the Thinking models and Lev decision models. Every number is
> recomputed from released per-item scores by ouro/scripts/paper_numbers.py.

Main findings (Ouro-2.6B; 95% paired bootstrap intervals in the paper):
- Prefill is 0.4-2.8% of the time of a chain-of-thought request.
- One decode loop: four prefill loops raise the 11-benchmark average from 44.2 (original) to 57.1 (fixed m=4) and
  56.8 (LoopBridge), above the original model distilled to one loop on the same data (49.8; rank 80: 50.2).
- Same measured time (about 11 s per request): +15.0 / +14.2 points over Original 1/1, +7.8 / +7.0 over Distilled 1/1.
- The gain peaks after two to five prefill loops (also for an adapter trained to 16 loops, over seeds, and with the
  prefill loops trained too).
- Transfers to Ouro-1.4B, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking (4/2 within 1.3 points of 4/4 on average at 3.2x decode throughput) and Lev.
- Baselines: the distilled controls move by at most 0.6 points over 0.3x-3x learning rates and at rank 80.

Limitations stated by the author: timing at batch 1 on one GPU type; at two decode loops untying and distillation tie
in time and a second decode loop buys more on long chain-of-thought; the prefill depth is fixed per setting; 4-shot
MATH-500 and HELMET exact recall do not gain; models up to 3B with four loops; English benchmarks.

## Docs
- README.md: findings, when to use, repository map
- REPRODUCE.md: every table and figure -> script -> result file; training and evaluation commands
- paper/untying-prefill-decode-loops.pdf: the paper
- ouro/results/items/: per-item scores of every run the paper uses; ouro/results/paper_numbers.json: the recomputed statistics
- ouro/results/provenance/: command, configuration, checkpoint hash, log and outputs of every run
